name: ship
description: /ship — take a feature from idea to merged in one command: worktree → discover → plan → build → review, gating only on design direction and 'go'. Auto-opening HTML storyboard (live mockups), plan card and review card, gate desktop notifications, a stage-aware status line, BUILD on Fable and Opus subagents, and Codex testing before merge, live with Pete in the Codex app when there is something to try. Bundles verify.
